component_status.note: Omni-Channel utility (widget) still to be added to the console app.
Edit access (design: Read) so customers can save their rating.
Visibility filter not set; the flow refuses unless status is Awaiting Customer Information.
Radio-button choices instead of data tables.
Bar charts and overdue metric built; top-20 overdue table not included.

deviations.reason: Classic HTML email templates merged in memory instead of Lightning templates (bulk-safe; renderStoredEmailTemplate costs queries per email).
deviations.proposed_design_change: Accept; revisit if the business needs Lightning template editing.

deviations.reason: RequestAssignmentService runs without sharing (audit data written for any user from the trigger).
Shared MaintenanceMessaging helper reads customer contact details in system mode; reminder flow uses an invocable action instead of Send Email elements.
Guest/portal-created requests are routed through the Maintenance_Routing__e platform event (Automated Process user), because those licences cannot access Omni-Channel objects.
deviations.proposed_design_change: Add Maintenance_Routing__e and MaintenanceRoutingTrigger to the design.

deviations.reason: Sharing set grants Edit, not Read, so customers can save their rating (CMP-117/119).
deviations.proposed_design_change: Update CMP-018 access to Edit; field security limits changes to the rating.

deviations.reason: Record type checked by Id lookup instead of an entry formula (cross-object formulas are not evaluated on create in before-save flows).
Radio-button choice lists instead of data tables; postcode-only property search.
Quick-action visibility filters not set (also CMP-111, CMP-114); flows refuse with a clear message.
deviations.proposed_design_change: Add Dynamic Actions visibility in a follow-up.

deviations.reason: Team and supervisor access verified by scripts/apex/verify-sharing.apex on real records (36/36), because this org calculates criteria-based shares asynchronously (also CMP-076).
deviations.proposed_design_change: Accept; run the script after every deployment.

deviations.reason: Dashboard overdue table component not included.

reviewer_focus: Documented without-sharing exceptions: MaintenanceRequestIntakeService (guest intake), RequestAssignmentService, MaintenanceMessaging contact reads
Platform-event routing for guest and portal requests (Maintenance_Routing__e)
Sharing set Edit access for portal rating
Demo values for categories and teams (business TBC)
